materials: city_backdrop_emissive (emissive-only: base colour black, the matte strip as the emission texture at strength 1.0; unlit in effect, no light response)

bounds_cm.note: x, y up, z depth (glTF); a 180 degree arc of radius 10 m: 2000 wide, 600 high, 1000 deep (the half circle); height runs from -1.0 m to +5.0 m about the pivot

pivot: the arc centre on the floor plane (the centre of the half circle, height 0). The arc lies on +Y in Blender (+Z in the GLB), behind a viewer at the near edge of the table. Put the pivot at the light table pivot; the panel bottom is 1.0 m below it so the horizon band sits near 1.4 m.
scale_reasoning: No plan gives a window size (wolf-plan.md and plan.md only say "a matte panorama behind the windows"), so the panel is the fallback: a 180 degree arc. Radius 10 m (far enough that head motion has little parallax against a table of 1.2 x 0.8 m), 6 m tall. The strip shows rows 0.05 to 0.65 of the picture (the sky above and the dark ground below are cut), about 1.75 x 1.3 cm per texel. Wolf may rescale to the real windows.
textures: textures/city_backdrop_basecolor.png: 1792 x 768 PNG, the wide matte strip. The picked frame's last 256 columns are cross-faded into its first 256, so the right edge continues into the left (tileable horizontally; edge step 0.00501 against 0.00312 for a typical neighbouring column pair, 0.03223 before the fade). Dimmed by a factor 0.55 in encoded sRGB (max luminance 0.5466, 99th percentile 0.2249, mean 0.0928). Wire it as the emissive colour; no normal or ORM map (a matte painting has no surface).

generator.prompt: a wide night city backdrop matte painting for the windows of a dark studio. Dense low skyline of mixed mid-rise towers of even height along one level horizon, hazy and far, the sky a calm dark blueprint blue fading lighter at the horizon. Backdrop rules: one wide panoramic strip of a night city skyline seen from a high studio window, far away across the whole width, a low horizon band that continues seamlessly at the left and right edges, low contrast, dim, soft hazy depth, small distant warm and cool window lights, no foreground, no window frame, no mullions, no glass reflections, no room interior, no people, no sky objects, no text, no signs, no logos, no lettering. Materials: distant towers as soft near-black blue silhouettes, sparse tiny amber and warm paper window lights, a faint cyan-white haze along the horizon, blueprint blue night haze in the sky, matte painted finish. Palette with roles: ground: blueprint blue #0B2A6B to #123A8C; linework and volumes: cyan-white #BFE8FF; attention (pins, scan, agent head): amber #FFB547; decision accents: warm paper #F3E9D2; studio: near-black blue #0A0F18. Finish: soft bloom on edges, light haze, warm practical lights against a cool table, slight film grain. Never: galaxy or star imagery, neon cyberpunk clutter, fisheye, readable fake text, purple gradients.

The prompt uses the backdrop rules (wide night skyline from a high studio window, low contrast, dim, no foreground, no window frame, no text or logos, seamless horizon band) and restates the style block palette and finish. The picked frame is a dim blueprint-blue night skyline with sparse amber window lights, no frame and no text, like the city seen through the windows in lookdev/00-hero.jpg.
